title: Workspace encryption
unavailable: Encryption setup requires verified maintainer or administrator authority and no existing setup. Existing keys are never replaced here.
setupEvidenceOnly: Saved-key metadata is setup evidence, not proof that the keys match or that runner decryption succeeds.
retrySameKey: The public configuration request is retained. Retry uploads the same private key held in this client session.
adminResolution: An administrator must resolve the existing configuration and saved key before a new setup. A lost private key cannot be recovered here. Review the existing request; no key will be regenerated or overwritten.
statusUnavailable: Sensitive input requires an applied public configuration and recorded private-key registration. Setup status needs metadata read access, including for ordinary requesters; no write grant is required. Runner decryption is verified separately.
statusCheckFailed: The public configuration request was created, but setup status could not be checked. Retry checks the existing request before uploading the same private key; no new key is generated.
uploadFailed: Private key upload failed. The public configuration request is retained.
